name: The Lantern Daily — Master Newsroom Production Pipeline

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  title: $json.headline,
  slug: $json.headline.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '') + '-' + Date.now().toString().slice(-4),
  content: $json.summary,
  excerpt: $json.summary,
  section: $json.section,
  outlet_count: $json.outlet_count,
  outlets: $json.outlets,
  source_url: $json.source_url,
  status: 'draft',
  content_type: 'issue'
}) }}
